name: HALLUCINOGEN
description: HALLUCINOGEN is a visual question answering benchmark designed to evaluate object hallucination in large vision-language models using diverse contextual reasoning prompts. It includes a medical domain extension called MED-HALLUCINOGEN to assess hallucination in biomedical images.
reputation: HALLUCINOGEN is a recent specialized benchmark with emerging adoption in vision-language hallucination research, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes hallucination attack prompts for general and medical domains; evaluates multiple LVLMs and mitigation strategies.
